name: potpie-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Potpie, a platform that gives coding agents a shared context graph of a
project's services, decisions and history. Its context graph core package, `potpie_context_core`, is a pure
library (pydantic and the standard library only) that defines the graph ontology and contract, entity identity,
the semantic mutation DSL with its validation, risk and approval policy, lowering into structural graph
mutations, reconciliation planning and validation, and the graph workbench and query/read models, together
with the ports that the context engine implements.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the context graph core package of this repository: potpie/context-core/src/potpie_context_core/ (its modules, its ports/ subpackage and the playbook it ships), together with the documentation pages docs/context-graph/writing.md and docs/context-graph/ontology.md and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
in-package docstrings, including their examples; in-package code comments are only supporting
evidence, and when a comment conflicts with the documentation, follow the documentation.
